# Command-Line Help for `keystone`

This document contains the help content for the `keystone` command-line program.

**Command Overview:**

* [`keystone`↴](#keystone)
* [`keystone serve`↴](#keystone-serve)
* [`keystone docs`↴](#keystone-docs)
* [`keystone hash-password`↴](#keystone-hash-password)

## `keystone`

KeyStone server: unlimited-node monitoring, per-node Docker, living /help

**Usage:** `keystone [COMMAND]`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `serve` — Run the HTTP UI and gRPC ingest (default)
* `docs` — Print living documentation (same text as /help) to stdout
* `hash-password` — Hash a password for `auth.password_hash` (reads KEYSTONE_ADMIN_PASSWORD or prompt via stdin)



## `keystone serve`

Run the HTTP UI and gRPC ingest (default)

**Usage:** `keystone serve [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `-c`, `--config <CONFIG>` — Path to TOML config

  Default value: `/etc/keystone/server.toml`



## `keystone docs`

Print living documentation (same text as /help) to stdout

**Usage:** `keystone docs [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `--section <SECTION>`

  Default value: `all`



## `keystone hash-password`

Hash a password for `auth.password_hash` (reads KEYSTONE_ADMIN_PASSWORD or prompt via stdin)

**Usage:** `keystone hash-password`
